children: Michael Williams disclosed a 78.24% beneficial stake in Bravo Multinational Inc., largely through convertible preferred shares held by MWP Entertainment Group, LLC. He filed the Schedule 13D on Oct. 06, 2026, after closing a deal on Sept. 18, 2026. The move gives Williams effective voting control and a board leadership role at the company.

Williams took an immediate governance role, stating he was "appointed Chairman of the Board effective September 18, 2026," after the board was reconstituted. He and MWP now "control a majority of the Issuer's voting power" and plan to vote at the annual meeting on the election of directors and the 2026 Stock Incentive Plan.

MWP also holds a one-year option to buy more preferred stock for $1.5 million at the same price as the initial deal, which could further strengthen control if exercised. Williams may also make additional share purchases or sales as he evaluates the company’s prospects.

Michael Williams is an American entertainment executive and investor who focuses on media and technology ventures. He serves as Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of MWP Entertainment Group, LLC, a Nevada company that develops, produces, finances, and manages entertainment content and technology. Williams typically pursues control-oriented positions to drive strategic and operational changes.
